verses: Bari kharabi hai her aisay shakhs ki jo aib tatolney wala gheebat kerney wala ho
Jo maal ko jama kerta jaye aur ginta jaye
Woh samjhta hai kay uss ka maal uss kay pass sada rahey ga
Hergiz nahi yeh to zaroor tor phor denay wali aag mein phenk diya jaye ga
Aur tujhay kiya maloom kay aisi aag kiya hogi?
Woh Allah Taalaa ki sulgai hui aag hogi
Jo dilon per charhti chali jaye gi
Woh unn per her taraf say band ki hui hogi
